pages.lead: BaZi tells you when elemental seasons shift. Zi Wei Dou Shu shows where in your life map those shifts land. Both empower destiny — but at different resolution.

sections.body: Four Pillars of Destiny compresses your birth year, month, day, and hour into elemental chemistry. Practitioners use Ten Gods, luck pillars, and annual stems to answer: Is this a wealth year? A relationship test? BaZi excels at macro timing — the weather system moving through your life.

sections.h2: What Zi Wei Dou Shu Adds
sections.body: Purple Star Astrology maps 14 major stars across 12 palaces — Life, Wealth, Career, Spouse, Health, Travel, and more. Instead of only asking when, ZWDS asks where: which life domain is activated, which star carries authority, and which Si Hua transformation (Lu, Quan, Ke, Ji) is pressing that palace this year.

If you want elemental strategy and decade luck pillars, start with BaZi. If you want palace-level career/love/wealth narratives in plain English, start with a free ZWDS chart. Many serious readers use both — BaZi for timing windows, ZWDS for domain-specific action plans.

pages.faq_q: Can BaZi and Zi Wei Dou Shu be used together?
pages.faq_a: Yes. BaZi emphasizes elemental cycles and luck pillars; ZWDS emphasizes star placements and palace activations. Together they answer when and where — the two questions most seekers actually care about.

pages.lead: Feng Shui adjusts the room. Zi Wei Dou Shu reads the person in the room. Confusing the two is the most common mistake English-speaking seekers make.

sections.body: Classical Feng Shui analyzes landform, facing direction, flying stars, and room layout to harmonize qi in physical space. It is indispensable for offices, bedrooms, and renovation timing — especially when you control the environment but feel blocked anyway.

sections.h2: Zi Wei Dou Shu: Internal Life Map
sections.body: ZWDS uses birth date, hour, and gender to construct a 12-palace natal board. It reveals innate tendencies in career appetite, wealth style, relationship patterns, and health constitution. No amount of furniture rearrangement replaces knowing which palace is under annual pressure.

sections.h2: Practical Stack for North American Seekers
sections.body: Use Feng Shui when you are moving, renovating, or optimizing a workspace. Use ZWDS when you are choosing careers, partners, investment timing, or understanding recurring life themes. Generate your English chart first — then apply Feng Shui to support weak palaces, not instead of reading them.

pages.faq_q: Does Feng Shui replace a birth chart reading?
pages.faq_a: No. Feng Shui works on space; ZWDS works on natal structure and annual overlays. The strongest approach combines both: chart for timing and domain focus, Feng Shui for environmental support.
